overview_description: Create, read, change, cancel and delete Exsited orders, quotes and contracts, with their lines, notes and billing.
intro: An order is what an account buys: its lines, billing preferences, invoices and payments. This area creates and reads orders, quotes and contracts, changes their lines and billing, moves them through their states, and manages their notes and files. It has 60 endpoints, and every SDK supports all of them.
warning: **Only the preview endpoints are dry runs.** Every other state change, such as `upgrade`, `cancel` or `discard_draft`, takes effect at once. Discarding a draft removes it, so the order can no longer be read.
notes: **Most order bodies go under `order`.** The exceptions are `upgrade`, `downgrade`, `contract_adjustment` and their previews (`effective_date` and `lines` at the top level), the dormant invoice call (`activate`), the express call (`account`), and the note calls, which take a multipart form.
**A contract needs a recurring or metered item on a line.** Set `allow_contract` to `true` and send `contract_properties` when you create the order.
**Lines are named two ways.** Line paths take the line's `id` as `line_uuid`; a change body names a line by its `charge_item_uuid`, sent as `uuid`.
**Previewing an order can still create an account.** `POST /orders/preview` creates no order, but a body that names a new account creates that account.
**Payments and fulfillments are not checked against the order.** `GET /orders/{order_id}/payments/{payment_id}` and `.../item_fulfillments/{fulfillment_id}` read the record by its own `id`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Send `limit`, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.

endpoints.title: List orders
endpoints.summary: Lists orders, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: The records are under `data`, and `pagination` holds the cursor for the next page. Each record holds the order's header fields; read one order for its lines and totals. To filter, add `filter_<field>=<value>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` to sort in descending order.

endpoints.title: Create an order
endpoints.summary: Creates an order for an account and returns it under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send the order under `order`, with the account's `id` as `account_id` and at least one line naming an item. Set `quote_order` to `true` for a quote, `pre_order` for a pre-order, or `allow_contract` with `contract_properties` for a contract; a contract needs a recurring or metered item on a line. A regular order is created as `active`.

allow_contract.description: `true` makes the order a contract. A contract needs a recurring or metered item on a line.

properties.description: Billing preferences for the order; they are read back under `billing_preferences`.

quote_order.description: `true` creates a quote instead of a regular order.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an order
endpoints.summary: Returns one order with its lines, totals and KPIs, under `order`.
endpoints.description: Pass the order's `id`. The response holds the order's header fields, its `lines`, `billing_preferences`, `kpis` and `total`.

404.description: No order has that `id`, for example after it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Delete an order
endpoints.summary: Deletes an order and returns no content.
endpoints.description: Pass the order's `id`. A successful delete returns `204` with an empty body, and reading the order afterwards returns `404`.

204.description: The order is deleted. The body is empty.

endpoints.title: Activate an order
endpoints.summary: Activates an order from the date you give.
endpoints.description: Send `effective_date` under `order`. After the call the order's `status` is `active`. The response body is not documented yet.

effective_date.description: The date the change takes effect, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

endpoints.title: Activate a draft order
endpoints.summary: Activates a draft order, such as a quote, and returns it under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send `effective_date` and an optional `note` under `order`. After the call the order's `status` is `active`.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The quote's order `id`. A quote is an order created with `quote_order: true`.

effective_date.description: The date the change takes effect, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an order's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Returns an order's billing preferences, under `order.billing_preferences`.
endpoints.description: Pass the order's `id`. The preferences cover how the order is invoiced, paid and fulfilled, such as `invoice_mode`, `billing_period` and `payment_term`.

endpoints.title: Update an order's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Changes some of an order's billing preferences and returns the order under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send the preferences to change under `order.billing_preferences`, such as `invoice_mode`. Read the preferences again to see the stored values.

endpoints.title: Replace an order's billing preferences
endpoints.summary: Sets an order's billing preferences with `PUT` and returns the order under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send the preferences under `order.billing_preferences`, as for the `PATCH` call. Read the preferences again to see the stored values. Whether fields you do not send are cleared is not documented.

endpoints.title: Cancel an order
endpoints.summary: Cancels an order from the date you give and returns it under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send `effective_date` under `order`. After the call the order's `status` is `inactive`; reactivate it to bring it back.

effective_date.description: The date the change takes effect, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

endpoints.title: Change an order's lines
endpoints.summary: Adds, changes or removes order lines from a date and returns the order under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send `effective_date` and a list of `lines` under `order`. Each line has an `op`: `add` with an `item_id` and `item_order_quantity`, `change` with the line's `charge_item_uuid` as `uuid` and a new `item_order_quantity`, or `remove` with the `uuid` alone.

endpoints.title: Convert a quote to an order
endpoints.summary: Turns a quote into a new regular order and returns the new order under `order`.
endpoints.description: Send an empty body. The new order has its own `id` and `order_type` `REGULAR`, and the quote stays readable with `quote_converted` set to `true`.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The quote's order `id`. A quote is an order created with `quote_order: true`.

endpoints.description: Send `trial_start_date` and `trial_end_date` under `order`. The new window starts after the current trial ends, and the order's `contract_properties.trial_end_date` takes the new end date.

endpoints.description: Pass the order's `id`. The response holds fields such as `name`, `description`, `currency`, the addresses and the dates, but no lines or totals.

endpoints.title: Preview an order
endpoints.summary: Checks an order body without creating the order.
endpoints.description: Send the same body as create order. No order is created, and the response holds only an empty `activity_logs` under `order`. A body that names a new account still creates that account.

allow_contract.description: `true` makes the order a contract. A contract needs a recurring or metered item on a line.

properties.description: Billing preferences for the order; they are read back under `billing_preferences`.

quote_order.description: `true` creates a quote instead of a regular order.

endpoints.title: Create an order through the express path
endpoints.summary: Creates an order, and its invoice and payment if the body nests them, in one call.
endpoints.description: Send the account's `id` and the order under `account`, as for `POST /express`. Nest an invoice and payment in the body to create them in the same call.
endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work as described.** `POST /orders/express` currently behaves as [Create an order](/api-reference/orders/create-an-order). To create an order with its invoice in one call, use [Create an order with its invoice](/api-reference/express/create-an-order-with-its-invoice).

endpoints.title: Accept an order
endpoints.summary: Accepts an order that is waiting for customer acceptance.
endpoints.description: Send no body. Accepting raises an invoice for the order and may require a payment.
endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work.** The response body is not documented yet.
